metadata.title: Democrats’ Big Election Win Sets Up a Debt Ceiling Fight. What It Means for Bonds.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Democrats’ Big Win Sets Up a Debt Ceiling Fight. What the Election Means for Bonds.
Democrats’ sweeping victory in the midterm elections is fueling concerns about the possibility of a contentious debt ceiling battle and higher interest rates in coming months that could keep bond markets on edge.
